AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized competition administrator record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

ReviewSubmission.title: ReviewSubmission
ReviewSubmission.description: College software funding competition review submission with contact details, geolocation verification, and Google Drive selfie verification metadata.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who submitted the review.

reviewerName.description: Full name of the reviewer or participant.

email.description: Contact email address submitted in Step 1.

phone.description: Contact phone number submitted in Step 1.

projectTitle.description: Name of the college software project being reviewed.

reviewNotes.description: Written evaluation comments for the competition project.

location.description: Geolocation coordinates and accuracy captured with explicit browser permission (latitude, longitude, accuracyMeters, capturedAtIso).

faceVerification.description: Client-side selfie verification result (passed, method, livenessScore, summary, verifiedAtIso).

driveFile.description: Google Drive file metadata for the uploaded selfie image (fileId, fileName, webViewLink, folderId, uploadedAtIso).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when location permission was granted and submission was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Competition administrators allowed to audit all review submissions.

/submissions/{submissionId}.description: Verified competition review submissions containing contact PII, GPS verification, and Google Drive selfie references.
